tanf_financial.description: One table of the TANF and MOE Financial Data workbook for a fiscal year (federal TANF and state maintenance-of-effort expenditures reported on the ACF-196R): A.1 national spending by category (federal, state MOE, all funds), A.2-A.4 comparisons with the prior year, A.5 federal funds available, A.6 federal funds by state (awards, carryover, transfers to CCDF and SSBG, expenditures, unliquidated and unobligated), B total (federal + MOE) by state and category, C.1 federal by state and category, C.2 state MOE by state and category, C.3 MOE spending against the 80%/75% requirement, a state's own category table (table = the state), E.1-E.5 by funding stream (SFAG, MOE in TANF, MOE in separate state programs, Contingency Fund), F transitional services and Job Access. Manual download only (acf.gov refuses scripts): --check writes the browser link, --ingest reads the saved .xlsx.

fiscal_year.desc: federal fiscal year (October-September), e.g. 2024; workbooks with the ACF-196R categories cover FY 2015 on

table.desc: table code (A.1, A.2 ... A.6, B, C.1, C.2, C.3, E.1 ... E.5, F), a state name or USPS code for that state's category table (Alabama, DC), or the exact sheet name; default A.1

header_row.desc: 1-based row(s) holding the column names, e.g. 2 or [4, 5]; default: detected

tanf_caseload.description: One table of the TANF caseload workbook for a fiscal year: families (total, two-parent, one-parent, no-parent) or recipients (total, adults, children) by state and month with the fiscal-year (and, in the 15-month files, calendar-year) average; one month's table by state (all seven counts); or the fiscal/calendar-year averages. program picks the TANF, separate state program (SSP-MOE) or combined TANF & SSP-MOE workbook. Manual download only (acf.gov refuses scripts).

fiscal_year.desc: federal fiscal year, e.g. 2025 (the FY 2018, 2024 and 2025 workbooks run 15 months, October to the next December, and add calendar-year averages)

program.desc: tanf (default): families and recipients in TANF; ssp: separate state programs funded with MOE (SSP-MOE); tanf_ssp: the two combined

table.desc: families (default), two_parent, one_parent, no_parent, recipients, adults, children (by state and month); avg_families or avg_recipients (fiscal- and calendar-year averages); a month as YYYY-MM (one month, all counts by state); or the exact sheet name

header_row.desc: 1-based row(s) holding the column names; default: detected

ccdf_expenditures.description: One table of the CCDF expenditure workbooks (ACF-696 reports): file all_years = spending during a fiscal year from all grant years (Table 1a by fund and grant year, 2a unliquidated funds, 3a by state and category: admin, quality, infant/toddler quality, direct services, non-direct services; 4a by state and fund: mandatory, federal and state matching, discretionary, MOE, CARES, CRRSA, ARP); file grant_year = one grant year's award as of a quarter end (Table 1b by category, 2b awards and TANF transfers by state, 3b mandatory, 4b matching, 5b state match, 6b discretionary, 7b-8b MOE, later tables the supplemental funds). Manual download only (acf.gov refuses scripts).

fiscal_year.desc: fiscal year (file all_years) or grant year (file grant_year), e.g. 2022

file.desc: all_years (default): FY spending from all appropriation years (tables 1a-4a); grant_year: one grant year's award (tables 1b-8b, more for 2020-2021)

as_of.desc: grant_year only: year of the September 30 quarter end of the report (a grant year is reported as of 9/30 of the grant year and of up to two later years); default the latest known

table.desc: table number such as 4a, 3a, 1b, 2b (or 'Table 4a'), or the exact sheet name; default 4a (all_years) or 1b (grant_year)

header_row.desc: 1-based row(s) holding the column names; default: detected

verified: 2026-10-30, from Internet Archive captures of the acf.gov pages (acf.gov itself refuses scripts)
